channel.title: Pier & Point · Potrero Power Station Block 12
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 12 (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 12: The City's Legistar pages list the amended…
item.description: The City's Legistar pages list the amended development agreement (File 260724) and its zoning ordinance (File 260770) as approved by the Mayor and enacted on October 13, 2026 (Enactment Nos. 208-26 and 209-26). An open question and the September 29 timeline entry still said enactment was not confirmed or still to come; they now match the Legistar pages. Both ordinances say 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment' (File 260770 §5(a) and File 260724, in each file's 'Leg Final' attachment), which makes November 13, 2026 the effective date by our count, a legal date computed by Pier & Point and not printed in the text; the heights and uses in the enacted text are not yet checked against this record. The record's timeline now has an entry for the Board's final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes), before the Mayor's approval. Source: SF Board of Supervisors, Legistar, BOS File 260724 and File 260770 (https://sfgov.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=8127453&GUID=CC4AC1DD-BF51-4585-86E8-0A5D44AA3745); Clerk of the Board's 'Leg Final' attachments: https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063745&GUID=68B0CE5F-84C2-4368-BF8D-EEA7D8B92E55 and https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063746&GUID=9EA91A49-BBF9-4471-9EA9-6E7BD33A4353.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 12: The Board's ordinance as enacted on October 13, 2026…
item.description: The Board's ordinance as enacted on October 13, 2026 sets new height limits for Block 12: 123 ft, or 115 ft if the building is majority non-residential (Note 2). They take effect 31 days after enactment, November 13, 2026 by our count; until then the earlier limits (100 ft) apply. Source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, p. 29 (Figure 249.87-2 'Building Heights Maximum') and p. 56 (§5(a): 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment'); Legistar: Final action and Enactment date 10/13/2026, Enactment # 209-26. File 260724 attachment p. 10: 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment.'.
item.source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, p. 29 (Figure 249.87-2 'Building Heights Maximum') and p. 56 (§5(a): 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment'); Legistar: Final action and Enactment date 10/13/2026, Enactment # 209-26. File 260724 attachment p. 10: 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment.'

item.title: Added · Potrero Power Station Block 12: The Planning Department's October 7, 2020 Phase 1 approval…
item.description: The Planning Department's October 7, 2020 Phase 1 approval includes Block 12, so the record now shows 'Planned · Approved'. This is approval of the development phase, not of the building's design, which has not been approved as far as we found. Source: Planning Department, Potrero Power Station Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment Applications: Development Phase Approval, Oct 7, 2020 (149 pages; sfplanning.org Potrero Power Station page, M-Files link), PDF p. 4: "approves the Phase 1 Plan Application dated October 6, 2020".

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 12: Mayor approves the Amended and Restated… (Oct 13, 2026)
item.description: Mayor approves the Amended and Restated Development Agreement (BOS File 260724) and the Planning Code and Zoning Map ordinance for the Potrero Power Station Special Use District (BOS File 260770): Legistar lists both as 'Status: Passed' with 'Final action: 10/13/2026', 'Enactment date: 10/13/2026' and enactment numbers 208-26 (File 260724) and 209-26 (File 260770), and a history row '10/13/2026 ... Mayor ... APPROVED' for each. The Board's final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes) is the previous entry on this timeline. October 13, 2026 is the enactment date, from the Clerk of the Board's listing (page read October 14 and again October 17, 2026); it is an event date. Both ordinances provide 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment' (File 260770 §5(a), p. 56 of its 'Leg Final' attachment; File 260724, p. 10 of its attachment); counted from October 13, 2026 that is November 13, 2026, a legal date computed by Pier & Point and not printed in the text. (Oct 13, 2026). Source: SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13.

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 12: Board of Supervisors finally passes the… (Oct 6, 2026)
item.description: Board of Supervisors finally passes the Amended and Restated Development Agreement ordinance (BOS File 260724) and the Planning Code and Zoning Map ordinance for the Potrero Power Station Special Use District (BOS File 260770): the Clerk of the Board's 'Leg Final' attachment to each file lists 'October 06, 2026 Board of Supervisors - FINALLY PASSED', 'Ayes: 11 - Chan, Chen, Dorsey, Fielder, Mahmood, Mandelman, Melgar, Sauter, Sherrill, Walton and Wong' (File 260724 attachment pp. 11-12; File 260770 attachment pp. 58-59), and the Clerk's certificate says each ordinance 'was FINALLY PASSED on 10/6/2026 by the Board of Supervisors'. The date is the Board's vote date, an event date. The Legistar history row for 10/6/2026 on each file's web page carries no action text, so the attachment is the source for this entry. The Mayor's approval and enactment followed on October 13, 2026 (next entry). (Oct 6, 2026). Source: SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 12: The record no longer describes Blocks 11 and 12 as a…
item.description: The record no longer describes Blocks 11 and 12 as a combined life-science campus: the only source pairing them, the project engineer's page, describes about 430,000 sq ft of office, while the Design for Development permits laboratory and life-science uses on Block 12. The expected completion changed from 2028 (a press figure) to 2029, following the October 2020 Phase 1 approval's 2020-2029 schedule and SocketSite's block table (Block 12 vertical 2027-2029), still marked as a 2020 forecast. The Blocks 11 and 12 design review application milestone is now dated February 2021 and no longer described as the source for the bus shelter, the 'first names Block 12' wording was removed, the dead 2019 draft link was replaced with the final February 2020 document, and two source entries' publisher, title and date were corrected. Source: Meyers+ Engineers, Potrero Power Station Blocks 11, 12 & 15 project page (https://www.meyersplus.com/potrero-power-station); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Phase 1 Development Phase Approval, 2020-10-07 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); SocketSite, 2020-10-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2020/10/revised-phasing-for-massive-potrero-power-plant-redevelopment.html); California Barrel Company, 2024 Annual Compliance Report, 2025-03-28 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station).

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 12: Developer proposes a Development Agreement… (~Jul 2026)
item.description: Developer proposes a Development Agreement amendment increasing Block 12's permitted height by 23 feet, and giving Block 12 flexibility to become residential instead of commercial; the Chronicle's July 29, 2026 article says the Planning Commission considered the request 'On Thursday' (the hearing date is not stated there), and the commission approved the amendment unanimously, sending it to the Board of Supervisors (SF Standard, August 3, 2026); the Board of Supervisors then passed the amendment package on first reading on Sep 29, 2026 (next entry) (~Jul 2026). Source: San Francisco Chronicle (Laura Waxmann), 2026-07-29; The San Francisco Standard, 2026-08-03.

item.title: Planned · Potrero Power Station Block 12: Planning Department approves the Phase 1… (Oct 7, 2020)
item.description: Planning Department approves the Phase 1 Development Phase Application, which includes Block 12 (Development Phase Approval dated October 7, 2020, Case No. 2017-011878PHA, signed by Planning Director Rich Hillis): the approval lists 'Block 12 – Includes construction of approximately 177,000 square feet of commercial, 6,000 square feet of PDR, 25,000 square feet of entertainment, arts and recreation, and 27,000 square feet of accessory parking uses' (PDF p. 16), says the first phase consists of 'vertical improvements to Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, and 15' (PDF p. 2), and its Decision reads 'approves the Phase 1 Plan Application dated October 6, 2020' (PDF p. 4). The approval moves 'the construction of commercial buildings on Blocks 11, 12, and 15' into Development Phase 1 (PDF p. 3). The date is the approval's own date, an event date. This approves the development phase, not Block 12's building design; no design review approval has been found for the block. (Oct 7, 2020). Source: SF Planning, 2020-10-07.
item.source: SF Planning, 2020-10-07

item.title: Planned · Potrero Power Station Block 12: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero… (Apr 21, 2020)
item.description: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement covering the adopted Design for Development, whose Land Use Table (Table 3.1.1) lists Block 12 (the Planning Commission had voted 5-0 on January 30, 2020 to recommend approval of the project); the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date. (Block 12 was later named one of Phase 1's six blocks by the October 2020 Phase 1 Development Phase Application – a construction-phase assignment, not when it first entered the plan.) (Apr 21, 2020). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-11-14; SF Planning; SF Planning (document adopted by the Planning Commission; the D4D names no publisher), 2020-02-26.
